services.value: ASSET Laboratories provides full-service environmental analytical testing, including organic and inorganic analyses of water, groundwater, storm water, wastewater, soil, and hazardous waste samples. The site also describes services such as hexavalent chromium analysis by EPA Method 218.6/7199, multi-element detection by ICP-MS, customizable electronic data deliverables, and courier/field sampling services including grab sampling and 24-hr composite sampling.
